adversarialReview.objection: The facets route has no identified signal. STOP and file.
adversarialReview.response: The route is mounted before the auth gate and does not set req.brokerageAuth today. The identified signal exists in brokerageAuth.ts (authenticatedBrokerageUserId + extractBrokerageApiKey + verifySessionToken). Dispatch said quote the mechanism you will reuse and do not invent Clerk/Stripe. Reusing that existing session-Bearer path without 401ing the rest of the route is not inventing identity. STOP would apply if no such mechanism existed.
adversarialReview.disposition: Reuse authenticatedBrokerageUserId. Do not remount the whole route behind 401. Do not invent Clerk/Stripe.

adversarialReview.objection: Treat X-Hauska-Key operator/extension keys as identified so PE BFF always gets owner.
adversarialReview.response: S7 is identified-session inspect only. authenticatedBrokerageUserId requires tier===user and rejects anon_ ids. Operator keys are not a session. If the BFF always sends a service key, treating it as identified would leak owner to anonymous PE users before PE copies anything.
adversarialReview.disposition: Only authenticatedBrokerageUserId. Operator/extension keys stay anonymous for this field.

adversarialReview.objection: Copy pipeline ANY(bare parcel) because parcelNodeId is on the body.
adversarialReview.response: ANY(bare parcel) misses :{taxYear}. Closest pattern is landUseFactRead LIKE prefix:% plus 4-digit year.
adversarialReview.disposition: LIKE prefix:% on both parcel grammars. Tests throw on ANY(bare parcel), :sd:, and :boundary:.

adversarialReview.objection: Copying a CAD-roll owner name onto ownerFact would pass a naive presence check.
adversarialReview.response: Divergence: snapshot may carry owner-shaped junk; empty atoms still atom-miss for identified. Assert taxYear / entityId only from the gold fixture body. Memory fake throws on cad_property / cad-parcel-roll / GIS. Anonymous path never SELECTs.
